title:
The async effect to show a modal({@link UiSdlModal})

Payload
   modal: the id of the modal
   applicationStateForPayload: {
      id: the id of the application state
      trigger: the action type to trigger with the payload
   }
Modals tend to lose context of how they were opened and the payload that triggered its opening.
The `applicationStateForPayload` is a convenience that allows application developers to
trigger an effect with the payload. The effect can choose to store whatever it wants from the payload
in the application state.
name: UiSdlEpicShowUiSdlModal
